content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP® Certification in Columbus

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires a combination of formal education and project-management experience. Review PMI's specific requirements for your background—whether you hold a bachelor's degree, associate degree, or high school diploma—and document your project-management hours. Granite PM Academy's admissions team can help clarify whether you meet the prerequisites before enrollment.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP® Certification Training course. Our experienced certified practitioners deliver the full curriculum online, allowing you to learn on a schedule that fits your role at organizations like Aflac, Synovus, Global Payments, or Fort Moore. You'll cover the PMBOK® Guide framework, real-world case studies, and exam-focused practice.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After completing your 35 contact hours, submit your formal application to PMI, including verification of your education and project-management experience. Pay the associated PMI exam fee. Granite PM Academy provides guidance on documentation requirements and the application portal to ensure a smooth submission process.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources—practice tests, study guides, and Q&A sessions—to build confidence before your official PMP® exam. You'll schedule your proctored exam through PMI's authorized testing partner. Our instructors are available to clarify difficult concepts in the weeks leading up to your test date.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP® Credential
steps_items.text: Your PMP® certification is valid for three years. During this renewal cycle, earn Professional Development Units (PDUs) by attending training, conferences, volunteering, or engaging in self-directed learning. Track your PDUs in your PMI account and renew before expiration to keep your credential active and recognized across Columbus's public, military, healthcare, and financial sectors.
